structured_output.notes: Implemented strictly using Python 3 standard library (http.server, sqlite3, json, urllib.parse, threading, pathlib). Supports create_server(host, port, db_path) returning an HTTPServer instance running in a background daemon thread with ephemeral port support for isolated testing and clean teardown. Database queries use parameterized statements with LIKE escaping for search filtering and transactional integrity. Static file serving resolves assets relative to web/ with comprehensive path traversal sanitization.
structured_output.summary: Implemented the MiniLinks backend in examples/minilinks/app/database.py and examples/minilinks/app/server.py conforming to the product specification and test suites. Implemented SQLite database layer with bookmarks schema, timestamps, and full CRUD query helpers. Implemented HTTP REST API endpoints (GET /health, GET /api/bookmarks with ?q= filtering, POST /api/bookmarks, PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id>, DELETE /api/bookmarks/<id>), strict payload validation, and static asset delivery with directory traversal protection.
